_comment: Golden delegation cases for the orchestrated-subagents app. Every case carries a *recorded* coordinator draft, so the whole eval replays fixtures and issues no live model call -- following backend/tests/orchestrated/golden/merge_cases.json and the planning app's planning_cases.json. Preset cases carry the human-labelled expected pairing that scores the coordinator's choice; adversarial cases record what a model returned under an injection attempt, so the deterministic repair path is exercised against real misbehaviour rather than invented misbehaviour.
